name: Sorc 9er
notes: The sorcerer plays alone: not in the mafia chat, does not count towards parity, reads town to the cop, and hunts the cop. The console rolls their night 0 green (a random town player who is not the cop) on the pre-game card. The priest is a mortician: full role of one dead player each night. The hunter wins the 1v1 against the mafia.
